summary: Lancaster Gordon is a retired American professional basketball player born June 24, 1962. A 6'3" guard from the University of Louisville, he was the 1984 NBA first-round pick (8th overall) of the Los Angeles Clippers and played four NBA seasons there from 1984 to 1988. He later played parts of three Continental Basketball Association seasons from 1988 to 1991.
one_line: Retired American basketball guard drafted 8th overall by the Los Angeles Clippers in 1984, with later CBA stints.
key_facts: Lancaster Gordon was born on June 24, 1962.
Lancaster Gordon is a retired American professional basketball player.
Lancaster Gordon was selected by the Los Angeles Clippers in the first round (8th pick overall) of the 1984 NBA Draft.
Lancaster Gordon is a 6'3" guard from the University of Louisville.
Lancaster Gordon was selected as the Most Valuable Player in the 1983 NCAA Mideast Regional.
Lancaster Gordon played four NBA seasons for the Los Angeles Clippers from 1984 to 1988.
Lancaster Gordon played in 201 NBA games during his career.
Lancaster Gordon scored a total of 1,125 NBA points during his career.
Lancaster Gordon played parts of three Continental Basketball Association seasons from 1988 to 1991.
Lancaster Gordon averaged 8.2 points per game in 39 games for the Pensacola Tornados, La Crosse Catbirds and Sioux Falls Skyforce.
